title: 11 Best Herbal Creams For Postoperative Recovery
intro: Herbal creams for postoperative recovery are topical ointments made from various herbs and plants that are used to alleviate discomfort, pain, and inflammation associated with surgical procedures. These creams offer a range of benefits, including reducing scarring, promoting wound healing, and alleviating pain and itching, making them a popular choice for postoperative recovery. Examples of herbal creams used to treat this ailment include aloe vera, which soothes and calms the skin; chamomile, which reduces inflammation and promotes relaxation; tea tree oil, which has antimicrobial properties to prevent infection; and calendula, which accelerates wound healing and reduces scarring. Additionally, other herbal creams like arnica, peppermint, and lavender are also used to alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and promote relaxation during the postoperative recovery period.

preparations.preparation_desc: Calendula officinalis creams have been traditionally used to aid in the postoperative recovery process by accelerating wound healing, reducing inflammation, and promoting tissue repair. The anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties of these creams, which are attributed to the presence of triterpene saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, help to prevent infection and promote a conducive environment for healing. These bioactive constituents work synergistically to enhance collagen synthesis, improve tissue elasticity, and reduce scar formation, ultimately leading to a smoother and more rapid recovery. By incorporating Calendula officinalis creams into postoperative care, patients can experience reduced pain, improved wound closure rates, and enhanced overall recovery outcomes.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Acta physiologica et pharmacologica Bulgarica", Calendula officinalis creams for postoperative recovery stimulate physiological regeneration and epithelialization, likely due to increased metabolism of glycoproteins, nucleoproteins, and collagen proteins in the wound tissues.

preparations.preparation_desc: Aloe barbadensis creams have been widely used to treat postoperative recovery ailments due to their soothing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The gel extracted from the Aloe barbadensis plant contains bioactive constituents such as aloin, aloe-emodin, and vitamins A, C, and E, which help to reduce pain, inflammation, and promote wound healing. By applying Aloe barbadensis creams to affected areas, patients can experience rapid relief from postoperative recovery symptoms, including pain, redness, and swelling, allowing for a smoother and faster recovery process. The benefits of using Aloe barbadensis creams for postoperative recovery include reduced risk of infection, accelerated wound healing, and minimal scarring, making it an effective and natural remedy for this condition.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Brazilian journal of biology = Revista brasleira de biologia", Aloe barbadensis creams for postoperative recovery can accelerate wound healing due to the proliferation and cell migration of human skin fibroblasts and keratinocytes, in addition to being protective against cell death, as demonstrated by the in vitro clinical experiment in A. Vera solution by Teplick et al. (2018).

preparations.preparation_desc: Arnica montana creams have been used for centuries to aid in the postoperative recovery process, reducing inflammation and promoting healing. The anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties of this herbal preparation help to alleviate pain and discomfort associated with surgical procedures. The bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, in Arnica montana creams work synergistically to reduce swelling and promote tissue repair. By applying Arnica montana creams to affected areas, individuals can experience faster recovery, reduced scarring, and minimized risk of complications, making it a popular natural remedy for postoperative care.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Annals of plastic surgery", Arnica montana creams for postoperative recovery have been shown to decrease postoperative edema after rhinoplasty based on Level II reproducible evidence.

preparations.preparation_desc: Hypericum perforatum creams, derived from the herb St. John's Wort, have been traditionally used to aid in the postoperative recovery process, particularly in reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties of these creams help to soothe and protect the affected area, promoting a faster recovery. The bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, present in Hypericum perforatum creams exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities, further enhancing the healing process. By utilizing these creams, patients can experience reduced pain, inflammation, and scarring, leading to a more efficient and comfortable postoperative recovery.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Daru : journal of Faculty of Pharmacy, Tehran University of Medical Sciences", Hypericum perforatum creams for postoperative recovery have shown potential in promoting wound closure due to the presence of active principles such as flavonoids, glycosides, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which have been demonstrated to be effective in wound management.

preparations.preparation_desc: Echinacea purpurea creams are a popular herbal preparation used to aid in the postoperative recovery process by reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and boosting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Echinacea purpurea, including alkylamides, caffeic acid derivatives, and polysaccharides, have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that help to treat postoperative recovery ailments. By reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, Echinacea purpurea creams can help to minimize the risk of postoperative complications, such as infection and delayed healing. The benefits of using Echinacea purpurea creams include reduced recovery time, improved wound closure, and enhanced overall patient comfort.

Silybum marianum creams have been used to treat the postoperative recovery ailment, specifically to alleviate nausea and vomiting commonly experienced after surgery. This herbal preparation contains flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins that exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe the stomach and reduce the severity of nausea. The bioactive constituents of Silybum marianum creams, such as silibinin and silidianin, have been shown to inhibit the activity of certain enzymes involved in the emetic response, thereby reducing the occurrence of nausea and vomiting. By using Silybum marianum creams, patients can experience a faster and more comfortable recovery from postoperative surgery, with reduced risk of complications and improved overall well-being.

Glycyrrhiza glabra creams have been traditionally used to treat postoperative recovery ailments due to their anti-inflammatory and soothing properties, which help to reduce pain and discomfort. The bioactive constituents present in these creams, such as glycyrrhizin and flavonoids, contribute to their therapeutic effects by inhibiting inflammatory mediators and promoting wound healing. By applying Glycyrrhiza glabra creams topically, individuals can experience relief from postoperative pain, swelling, and scarring, ultimately facilitating a smoother and faster recovery process. The benefits of using these herbal creams include reduced reliance on pharmaceutical painkillers, minimized scarring, and accelerated wound closure, making them a valuable adjunctive therapy for postoperative care.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Evidence-based complementary and alternative medicine : eCAM", Glycyrrhiza glabra creams for postoperative recovery could promote cell proliferation and accelerate wound recovery at a rate of 2.12 ± 0.03% per hour.

preparations.preparation_desc: Hamamelis virginiana creams have been traditionally used to treat the postoperative recovery ailment known as surgical site inflammation. The anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties of this herbal preparation help to reduce swelling, pain, and infection at the surgical site, promoting a smooth and rapid recovery. The bioactive constituents of Hamamelis virginiana creams, including hamamelitannin and phenolic acids, exhibit potent antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities that contribute to their therapeutic effects. The benefits of using Hamamelis virginiana creams to treat postoperative recovery ailments include reduced pain and inflammation, improved wound healing, and a lower risk of complications, making it a valuable adjunctive therapy in surgical settings.

Symphytum officinale creams, derived from the common comfrey plant, have been traditionally used to aid in the postoperative recovery process, particularly in treating surgical wounds and reducing the risk of complications. This herbal preparation contains mucilages, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help to soothe and protect the affected area. By promoting tissue repair and reducing inflammation, Symphytum officinale creams can help to accelerate the healing process, minimize scarring, and reduce the risk of infection. The benefits of using Symphytum officinale creams include reduced recovery time, improved wound closure rates, and enhanced overall patient outcomes.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal of pharmacopuncture", Symphytum officinale creams for postoperative recovery may help accelerate the healing process of bruising, including enoxaparin injection-induced bruising, by reducing bruise size and promoting faster healing.

preparations.preparation_desc: Urtica dioica creams, derived from the leaves of the stinging nettle plant, have been traditionally used to treat postoperative recovery ailments such as pain, inflammation, and wound healing issues. This herbal preparation contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and lectins, which help to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and alleviate pain by inhibiting the production of pro-inflammatory enzymes. The anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties of Urtica dioica creams help to soothe and calm the skin, reducing the risk of complications and promoting a faster recovery. The benefits of using Urtica dioica creams for postoperative recovery include reduced pain and inflammation, improved wound healing, and a faster return to normal activities.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Molecules (Basel, Switzerland)", Urtica dioica creams for postoperative recovery have been found to accelerate wound healing, with wounds treated with an ointment of the extract healing in 9 days compared to 13 days for untreated wounds.

preparations.preparation_desc: Mentha x piperita creams have been traditionally used to treat postoperative recovery ailments due to their anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. These herbal preparations help to reduce pain and swelling by applying a topical application directly to the affected area, thereby promoting faster recovery and minimizing discomfort. The bioactive constituents of Mentha x piperita creams, including menthol, menthone, and limonene, have been found to exhibit potent anti-inflammatory and analgesic activities, which contribute to their therapeutic efficacy. By using Mentha x piperita creams, patients can experience the benefits of reduced pain, improved wound healing, and faster recovery, making it a valuable adjunct to traditional postoperative care.

Zingiber officinale creams, derived from the rhizomes of the ginger plant, have been used to treat postoperative recovery ailments due to their anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. These creams help to reduce pain and discomfort by inhibiting the production of pro-inflammatory enzymes and promoting the release of pain-relieving neurotransmitters. The bioactive constituents of Zingiber officinale creams, including gingerols and shogaols, have been found to exhibit potent anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which contribute to their therapeutic effects. The use of Zingiber officinale creams in postoperative recovery can lead to improved patient outcomes, reduced recovery time, and enhanced overall well-being.

Cinchona officinalis creams have been traditionally used to treat postoperative recovery ailments due to their anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. The herbal preparation helps to alleviate pain and reduce inflammation by promoting wound healing and preventing infection, thereby facilitating a smoother recovery process. The bioactive constituents of Cinchona officinalis, including quinine and alkaloids, possess antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties that contribute to its therapeutic effects. The benefits of using Cinchona officinalis creams for postoperative recovery include reduced pain and inflammation, accelerated wound healing, and a lower risk of infection, ultimately leading to a more comfortable and efficient recovery.

Ginkgo biloba creams have been traditionally used to treat postoperative recovery ailments, particularly those related to inflammation and oxidative stress. The herbal preparation's anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and terpenoids, help to reduce swelling and promote healing. The cream's antioxidant properties, which are a result of its high content of bilobalide and ginkgolides, help to protect tissues from oxidative damage and promote tissue repair. By reducing inflammation and oxidative stress, Ginkgo biloba creams can help to alleviate postoperative recovery symptoms, leading to faster healing, reduced pain, and improved overall outcomes.

Melissa officinalis creams have been widely used to treat the postoperative recovery ailment due to their anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to reduce swelling and prevent infection. These herbal creams contain bioactive constituents such as rosmarinic acid and luteolin, which have been shown to have analgesic and antispasmodic effects, thereby alleviating pain and discomfort. By applying Melissa officinalis creams topically, patients can experience faster recovery and reduced scarring, as the antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties of the herbal preparation help to promote tissue repair and reduce oxidative stress. The benefits of using Melissa officinalis creams to treat postoperative recovery ailments include reduced pain, improved wound healing, and enhanced overall recovery time, making it a valuable addition to traditional pain management therapies.

Lavandula angustifolia creams have been traditionally used to treat postoperative recovery ailments, such as pain, inflammation, and anxiety, due to their calming and soothing properties. The bioactive constituents, including linalool and linalyl acetate, have been shown to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and anxiolytic effects, which help to alleviate discomfort and promote relaxation. These creams are believed to work by reducing muscle tension, promoting wound healing, and modulating the body's stress response, ultimately contributing to a smoother postoperative recovery. The benefits of using Lavandula angustifolia creams for postoperative recovery include reduced pain and anxiety, improved sleep quality, and a faster return to normal activities.

Curcuma longa creams have been used to treat postoperative recovery ailments due to their anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and analgesic properties. These creams help to reduce pain and inflammation, promote wound healing, and alleviate symptoms such as swelling and redness, thereby facilitating a smoother recovery process. The bioactive constituents of Curcuma longa, including curcumin, demethoxycurcumin, and bisdemethoxycurcumin, are responsible for its therapeutic effects, which include inhibition of pro-inflammatory enzymes and cytokines. The benefits of using Curcuma longa creams for postoperative recovery include reduced risk of complications, improved wound healing, and enhanced patient comfort, making it a valuable adjunctive treatment option.

Panax ginseng creams have been utilized as an alternative treatment to aid in the postoperative recovery of patients, particularly in alleviating symptoms of fatigue, insomnia, and pain that often accompany surgical procedures. The adaptogenic and anti-inflammatory properties of Panax ginseng creams contribute to their efficacy in treating postoperative recovery ailments, as they help to modulate the body's response to stress and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Panax ginseng creams, including ginsenosides and panaxynol, have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which help to promote tissue repair and reduce oxidative stress. The use of Panax ginseng creams has been associated with various benefits, including reduced recovery time, improved mood, and enhanced overall well-being in patients undergoing surgical procedures.

Vitis vinifera creams, derived from the grapevine plant, have been traditionally used to aid in the postoperative recovery process by promoting wound healing and reducing inflammation. The anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties of Vitis vinifera creams help to treat the ailment by reducing pain and discomfort, promoting tissue repair, and preventing infection. The bioactive constituents of Vitis vinifera creams, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, contribute to their therapeutic effects by modulating the immune response and promoting collagen synthesis. Regular use of Vitis vinifera creams has been found to accelerate the recovery process, reduce scarring, and minimize the risk of complications, making it a valuable adjunctive therapy in postoperative care.

Taraxacum officinale creams have been utilized to alleviate postoperative recovery ailments, particularly wound healing and inflammation. The anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties of this herbal preparation, derived from the bioactive constituents including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, help to treat this ailment by reducing swelling and preventing infections. The creams also exhibit antioxidant and free radical scavenging activities, which facilitate the healing process and promote tissue repair. By utilizing Taraxacum officinale creams, patients can benefit from accelerated wound healing, reduced scarring, and improved overall recovery outcomes.

intro_study: According to "Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica", creams for postoperative recovery may be beneficial by stimulating the immune system and reducing blood viscosity, although the study specifically investigated Shenfu injection (SF) in this context.
